why_this_slot.text: Best modeled placement for Nolan Schanuel is slot #1 (4.346 expected team runs/game).
Slots #1, #2, #4, #5, #3 are within 0.01 runs/game of each other — essentially equivalent under the model’s operational band.
Primary actual slot #3 ranks 5 of 9; estimated placement opportunity vs best is +0.006 R/G.
Slot #1 yields 4.64 expected PA/game vs 4.42 at primary slot #3. Batting order changes both game states and plate appearances.
